```artifact
Feature: Alarms in the GUI and Controller

  Scenario: Input air line blocked
    Given the input air line is blocked
    When the system detects low pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Input air line blocked"

  Scenario: Input O2 line blocked
    Given the input O2 line is blocked
    When the system detects low pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Input O2 line blocked"

  Scenario: Inspiratory pressure drops below -4cm H2O
    Given the inspiratory pressure is below -4cm H2O
    When the system detects the pressure drop
    Then the device and GUI must display an alarm
    And the alarm message must be "Inspiratory pressure too low"

  Scenario: Input O2 line pressure too high
    Given the input O2 line pressure is too high
    When the system detects the high pressure
    Then the GUI must display an alarm with severity HIGH
    And the alarm message must be "Input O2 line pressure too high"

  Scenario: GUI unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    Given the GUI is unresponsive
    When the apnea time is reached
    Then the controller must trigger an alarm
    And the alarm message must be "GUI unresponsive"

  Scenario: Controller unresponsive for 1/2 of the apnea time
    Given the controller is unresponsive
    When the apnea time is reached
    Then the GUI must trigger an alarm
    And the alarm message must be "Controller unresponsive"

  Scenario: Overpressure alarm firing above 60 cmH2O
    Given the pressure is above 60 cmH2O
    When the system detects the overpressure
    Then the controller must trigger an alarm
    And the alarm message must be "Overpressure detected"

  Scenario Outline: Normal values for alarms
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the <alarm condition> is met
    Then the <alarm type> alarm must be triggered
    And the alarm message must be "<expected message>"

    Examples:
      | alarm condition                | alarm type | expected message                |
      | input air line blocked         | GUI        | Input air line blocked          |
      | input O2 line blocked          | GUI        | Input O2 line blocked           |
      | inspiratory pressure too low   | Device/GUI | Inspiratory pressure too low    |
      | input O2 line pressure too high  | GUI        | Input O2 line pressure too high |
      | GUI unresponsive               | Controller | GUI unresponsive                |
      | controller unresponsive        | GUI        | Controller unresponsive         |
      | pressure above 60 cmH2O        | Controller | Overpressure detected           |

  Scenario Outline: Edge values for alarms
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the <alarm condition> is met
    Then the <alarm type> alarm must be triggered
    And the alarm message must be "<expected message>"

    Examples:
      | alarm condition                | alarm type | expected message                |
      | input air line pressure at 0.1   | GUI        | Input air line blocked          |
      | input O2 line pressure at 0.1    | GUI        | Input O2 line blocked           |
      | inspiratory pressure at -4.01    | Device/GUI | Inspiratory pressure too low    |
      | input O2 line pressure at 60.01  | GUI        | Input O2 line pressure too high |
      | GUI unresponsive for 0.5 apnea | Controller | GUI unresponsive                |
      | controller unresponsive for 0.5 apnea | GUI | Controller unresponsive         |
      | pressure at 60.01 cmH2O        | Controller | Overpressure detected           |

  Scenario Outline: Invalid values for alarms
    Given the system is in normal operation
    When the <alarm condition> is met
    Then the <alarm type> alarm must not be triggered
    And the alarm message must be "<expected message>"

    Examples:
      | alarm condition                | alarm type | expected message                |
      | input air line pressure at 0.05  | GUI        | Input air line blocked          |
      | input O2 line pressure at 0.05   | GUI        | Input O2 line blocked           |
      | inspiratory pressure at -3.99    | Device/GUI | Inspiratory pressure too low    |
      | input O2 line pressure at 59.99  | GUI        | Input O2 line pressure too high |
      | GUI unresponsive for 0.25 apnea | Controller | GUI unresponsive                |
      | controller unresponsive for 0.25 apnea | GUI | Controller unresponsive         |
      | pressure at 59.99 cmH2O        | Controller | Overpressure detected           |
```
